# The age PUBLIC key that database backups are encrypted to.
#
# A public key is meant to be public. It can only encrypt, so it is committed
# here on purpose: versioned, visible, and one less secret living in GitHub.
#
# The matching PRIVATE key is the only thing that can decrypt a backup. It must
# never appear in this repository, in GitHub Actions, or in any log. It lives in
# a password manager, and a copy somewhere that is not the same laptop.
#
# To create the pair, once:
#
#     age-keygen -o awana-backup-key.txt
#
# That prints "Public key: age1...". Replace the placeholder line below with it,
# then put awana-backup-key.txt somewhere safe and delete it from Downloads.
#
# Lines starting with # are ignored by age.

age15zquj3lay39pydz4hphqrsyulhl3swdpwem5ynpqwsp69hdduvwqj600n5
